headline: South Africa Debt Ratios Fall After Upward Revision to Previous Year's GDP
summary: South Africa's National Treasury reported a decline in national debt ratios following a regular data revision. The update showed the economy was 5.3% larger last year than previously estimated.
why: South Africa's National Treasury manages government revenue and public finances. Higher estimated GDP lowers public debt-to-GDP ratios, improving sovereign credit metrics.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: A larger base economy reduces debt ratio metrics, easing sovereign debt sustainability concerns.
